title: Watering Plants II
summary: Alice and Bob water n plants arranged in a row, labeled from 0 to n-1.
statement: Alice and Bob water n plants arranged in a row, labeled from 0 to n-1. Alice starts from the 0th plant and moves right, while Bob starts from the (n-1)th plant and moves left. They water the plants simultaneously, refilling their cans instantly if needed. If they meet at a plant, Alice waters it if they have the same amount of water, or if they have different amounts, the one with more water waters it. Given the water needs of each plant and the capacities of their watering cans, determine the number of refills required to water all plants.
constraints: Alice waters from the left with capacity_a and Bob from the right with capacity_b; every plant need fits both cans.
They refill only when their current water cannot cover their next plant.
At a shared middle plant, the person with more remaining water waters; ties go to Alice. Return total refills.
reference_solution:
def minimum_two_person_refills(plants,capacity_a,capacity_b):
    left,right=0,len(plants)-1;water_a,water_b=capacity_a,capacity_b;answer=0
    while left<right:
        if water_a<plants[left]:water_a=capacity_a;answer+=1
        water_a-=plants[left];left+=1
        if water_b<plants[right]:water_b=capacity_b;answer+=1
        water_b-=plants[right];right-=1
    if left==right and max(water_a,water_b)<plants[left]:answer+=1
    return answer
